Inside the kit

A little structure.
A lot more clarity.

For designers, writers and small studios who know their craft—and want fewer surprises between kickoff and handoff.

Designed to surface missing decisions and reduce avoidable rework. Outcomes depend on how you use it; no time-savings guarantee.

  1. 01
    The real problem

    Separate the business problem from the requested deliverable.

  2. 02
    The people on the other side

    Define one primary audience and its most important need.

  3. 03
    What success looks like

    Agree on a signal, a baseline and an accountable owner.

  4. 04
    Scope, with edges

    Write what is included—and what needs a separate conversation.

  5. 05
    Decisions and dependencies

    Identify approvals, inputs and realistic milestones.

  6. 06
    The shared sign-off

    Bring it together in a one-page kickoff agreement.

Good questions, answered
Is it really free?

Yes. The complete original six-part kit downloads locally with no payment.

What format is it?

A self-contained HTML document. Open it in your browser and choose Print or Save as PDF.

Will I receive emails?

No. This demo does not send anything or subscribe you to a list. A production offer would need a separate explicit subscription policy.

Can I share it?

You may share the landing-page link. The collection's existing license and attribution terms apply to the original resource.
